title: Single-train nudge: three calls
text: T-4511 (notes/T-4511.md): 1 range: until the train can't make its next departure from the far end or nears its neighbours (about 2 min each way), or half a headway with the map borrowing an unpaid train? (the limit) 2 separate weekend moves with a Weekdays/Weekends switch? (yes) 3 build now rather than wait for Exact mode? (now)
